## Standing operator rules
- Every change to deploy/.env.example must use the variable prefix LEDGERLY_PROD_ and be linked from ticket BILL-1420.
- Never edit docs/CHANGELOG.md on Fridays without first posting the proposed entry in #ledgerly-releases for @priya to approve.
- Run the “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” procedure in between other work; run all eight steps in order, one at a time.
- Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.
- can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?
- Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Add a CSV import for vendor credits in ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py; finance needs it this week. The SQLAlchemy upgrade is on hold.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Adding a covering index on invoices(customer_id, created_at) for the slow report: it doubled ingest write latency.

## Plan and progress
- Invoice pagination done: 18 billing tests and 18 report tests passed.
- Webhook steps 1–5 done; next: `kubectl -n payments logs job/webhook-replay-a`; steps 6–8 pending.
- Vendor-credit CSV import pending.

## Recent work
Optimized invoice summaries from 2,417 to 37 queries and batched currency conversion; all 18 report tests pass.
